caption: The drawing features a geometric pattern centered on the page, constructed primarily from a series of square, triangular, and parallelogram shapes. The entire pattern is oriented as a diamond, with its points aligned to the top, bottom, left, and right of the image. The outermost layer of the diamond consists of alternating red and cream-colored squares, with the red squares detailed with small dots. Moving inward, the next layer forms a star pattern using blue trapezoidal and triangular shapes, which are speckled with white dots. Interspersed among the blue pattern are additional cream squares and red triangles. At the very center, there is a smaller square shape, also in cream. The composition overall uses a color palette of red, blue, white (cream), and small white dots within some shapes. The background of the drawing is an uncolored, blank beige or off-white space. The design is outlined in thin, dark lines, and the overall arrangement is symmetrical along both the vertical and horizontal axes passing through the center.
title: Quilt - "Double Star"
